question: The festival of Holika Dahan marks the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**victory of good over evil.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Holika Dahan** is a** Hindu festival** celebrated on the **full moon day** in the** Hindu month of Phalguna.**
 
• It marks the victory of **good over evil** as it symbolizes the** burning of the demoness Holika,** who tried to kill Prahlad, a devotee of Lord Vishnu.
 
• This festival is also known as **Chhoti Holi**, as it is celebrated a day before the main festival of Holi.
 
• Holika Dahan is celebrated by **lighting a bonfire** and performing rituals around it.
 
• This festival is celebrated with **great enthusiasm** and is a symbol of** hope and positivity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Holika Dahan** is an **agricultural festival** celebrated in different parts of India.
 
• **Durga Puja **is celebrated in the month of **October or November.**
 
• There are different regional new year celebrations in India, such as** Ugadi, Gudi Padwa, Vishu, etc.**
